project_type: Foundry Solidity smart-contract protocol: bonding-curve launchpad, Uniswap v4 hook, cross-chain (Monad<->Solana) migration doorway.
test_framework: forge-std (forge test); suites under test/{unit,integration,fuzz,invariant,mocks}. Baseline: 45 tests passing.
verification_instructions: Success criteria: (1) `forge build --force` completes with ZERO errors AND ZERO forge-lint/build warnings. Use --force because forge skips recompile when nothing changed, hiding warnings. Count warnings with: forge build --force 2>&1 | grep -cE '^warning\['. (2) `forge test` passes with no regressions vs the 45-test baseline. Both src/v1/ and src/v2/ compile together because src is the compile root.
snapshot_or_generated_files: out/ and cache/ are build artifacts (gitignored, regenerated by forge build). None checked in for this task.
setup_instructions: Dependencies vendored under lib/ (forge-std, openzeppelin-contracts, v4-core, v4-periphery, permit2). No install step. Working dir is the Foundry root: /home/ubuntu/project/retropick/retropick-protocol/contracts
environment_constraints: via_ir = true and optimizer enabled; builds are slower (~minutes). evm_version = cancun. Do NOT commit or push - leave changes in the working tree. Branch feat/vendor-v2-rebrand.
contribution_requirements: src is the compile root, so EVERY .sol under src/ (including new v1/ and v2/) compiles together. Duplicate contract/interface/library NAMES across v1 and v2 collide and MUST be avoided - the V1->V2 rename in the v2 tree prevents this. The project was just cleaned to ZERO forge-lint warnings; do not reintroduce any. Preserve all existing rationale/justification comments and any existing per-line lint suppressions (format: `// forge-lint: disable-next-line(<name>)`).
key_patterns: All V1 contracts live directly under src/ (src/, src/hooks/, src/interfaces/, src/libraries/). Every occurrence of the token `V1` and lowercase `v1` in src/*.sol is RetroPick protocol versioning - VERIFIED there are zero non-RetroPick uses of V1/v1 (Uniswap uses V4/v4, never V1). So within the copied v2 tree, replacing `V1`->`V2` and `v1`->`v2` is a safe, complete token rename. Revert message string literals embed the version, e.g. "RetroPickDoorwayV1: not owner" -> must become "RetroPickDoorwayV2: not owner". Tests ONLY import the Doorway contract + IRetroPickDoorwayV1 interfaces and its revert strings; tests must continue pointing at src/v1/ (V1 names unchanged), only the import PATH changes from ../../src/ to ../../src/v1/.
directory_structure: src/ (9 core contracts), src/hooks/ (RetroPickMemeHookV1 - Uniswap v4 hook), src/interfaces/ (3 interface files), src/libraries/ (2 math libs). Intra-src imports are RELATIVE (e.g. ./libraries/..., ../RetroPickBuybackVaultV1.sol from hooks/). External imports use remappings (@openzeppelin, @uniswap/..., permit2, forge-std) and are unaffected by moving files. test/ has no script/ dir (script/ is empty).
